passives.name: You Stand Before the Queen
passives.description: (Passive Effect) Reduces the damage Glicys takes by [Buff_V_4076001_11_2] if her underlings are not present. If Glicys is hit with a single-target attack while an underling is present, recovers [Buff_V_4076001_11_3] Weakness Gauge after being attacked. Increases damage dealt to non-Earth enemies and reduces damage taken from them. Reduces damage dealt to Earth enemies and increases damage taken from them.
